_comment: The Oregon District is part of Downtown Dayton. The Dayton Art Institute was split out into its own location per Changelog v1.3 — different enough in character to warrant a separate entry.
name: Downtown Dayton & the Oregon District
shortDescription: Brick storefronts, string lights over the sidewalk, and low evening sun coming straight down the street. Ohio's oldest neighbourhood, and it photographs like somewhere with a history.
bestFor: Grads and couples who want an urban look. Easy to pair with the Art Institute or Carriage Hill in the same evening.
restrooms: None on-site, but the Dublin Pub directly across the street has public restrooms.
parking: Limited, and often on side streets near the Oregon District.
